THE LOOKBOOK

THE ART OF MODERN AFRICAN DRESSING.

About

THE HOUSE OF B’ LUXURY

B’ Luxury Fashion Hub is a Gboko fashion house built on one belief: African dress deserves the same precision, patience and ambition as any luxury atelier in the world.

“Every piece leaves the workshop carrying two names — the House's, and the person it was made for.”

African fashion
Our references are local: the silhouettes, fabrics and ceremonies of the people we dress.
Craftsmanship
Fabric chosen for its weight, seams finished with care, every detail checked before a piece leaves the workshop.
Modern tailoring
Clean lines and a considered fit, so heritage pieces sit sharply on the modern body.
Individual expression
No two clients are dressed the same. Each piece is shaped by the person who wears it.
Luxury
Quiet, exact and lasting. Real luxury is never loud.
Fashion education
Through our physical training program we teach pattern drafting, sewing and the business of fashion.

DON'T JUST WEAR FASHION.
LEARN TO CREATE IT.

Join B’ Luxury Fashion Hub's physical fashion training program and develop practical fashion skills in a hands-on learning environment.
